omissions: Applause, microphone adjustment, repeated jokes, and the final tease about undisclosed research are not reproduced verbatim; no substantive conclusion is inferred from them.
boundary: Captions were reviewed; slides were not available as independently inspected source artifacts. Operating figures and policy opinions are attributed, not independently audited.
